title: Symbolon
description: Experimental contract, verification and evidence core for machine work. Local TEST-unit sandbox with reproducible acceptance checks and documented commercial validation. This deposit preserves a dated source snapshot of the implementation and documentation, with the limitations stated in the repository.
notes: Apache-2.0 applies to the software. Examples use synthetic TEST units; the software does not move real money or establish legal liability. Archival publication does not establish peer review, independent validation or production readiness.
